Console: only CSP report-only (allowlisted), info-level [PosSyncService] + [POS-WIZARD] logs - zero level=error. Network: only 201/200/204 (csp-report 204, broadcasting/auth 200, /api/auth/login 201, /api/admin/pos 201, parked-orders 201) - zero 4xx/5xx outside allowlist; no request >2000ms recorded. Root cause of B-001 confirmed in source (PosCashDrawerSessionDialog.vue + cashDrawer store + backend CashDrawerService).

findings.evidence: FISCAL CASH-RECONCILIATION SURFACE shows contradictory expected-amount across two views of the SAME active session. State 12a (active summary) DOM literally renders: 'Fond de caisse initial 50,00 EUR' / 'Mouvements 0' / 'Montant attendu 50,00 EUR'. State 12b ('Voir les mouvements', same session) renders a non-empty cash_movements ledger with >=7 order_payment IN rows: 2,00 / 4,00 / 150,00 (Kiosk cash collected at POS) / 144,00 (Kiosk cash collected at POS) / 42,00 / 4,00 / 6,00 EUR (list continues). Visible IN movements alone sum to >=352 EUR, so the TRUE expected drawer = 50 (float) + >=352 = >=402 EUR, NOT the 50,00 EUR the summary shows. The summary under-counts both movement count (0 vs >=7) and expected amount (50,00 vs >=402 EUR). Actionable-path proof: in PosCashDrawerSessionDialog.vue the active view's 'Cloturer la caisse' button is @click="mode = 'close'" (line 153) which does NOT call loadMovements; the close/reconcile view binds the SAME expectedTotal computed (data-testid=cash-session-close-expected, line 208-209) and the on-screen variance = closingAmount - expectedTotal (line ~394). So a cashier who goes active -> Cloturer WITHOUT first clicking 'Voir les mouvements' is shown expected=50,00 EUR and a FAKE variance, and reconciles the drawer against that wrong figure.
findings.root_cause: PosCashDrawerSessionDialog.vue computeds movementsCount = this.movements.length (line 382-383) and expectedTotal = CashDrawerService.computeExpected(opening, this.movements) (line 388-391) both derive from the Vuex getter cashDrawer/movements. That array is ONLY hydrated by cashDrawer/loadMovements (store/modules/cashDrawer.js line 153), dispatched EXCLUSIVELY from openMovements() (dialog line 495-503) on the 'Voir les mouvements' click. PosComponent mount calls cashDrawer/loadCurrentSession (PosComponent.vue line 2407/2442) which commits setCashDrawerSession but NEVER fetches movements. Hence in 'active' and 'close' modes movements=[] -> count 0, expected = opening only.
findings.mitigation_context: NOT a persisted-data corruption: backend CashDrawerService::reconcileSession (app/Services/Cash/CashDrawerService.php line 257-262) authoritatively recomputes expected = opening_amount + sum(signed cash_movements) from the DB on close; it does NOT trust the client-displayed expectedTotal. So the saved Z/cash-trail variance is correct. The defect is the WRONG NUMBER SHOWN TO THE OPERATOR on the reconciliation surface they act on (count-out + variance-explain) - a cash-control risk and a hard numeric mismatch between two surfaces of the same fiscal session.
findings.fix_hint: resources/js/components/admin/cash/PosCashDrawerSessionDialog.vue - hydrate movements whenever an OPEN session is shown so active+close summaries are truthful. Options: (a) in resolveMode() line 456-462, after setting mode='active', dispatch cashDrawer/loadMovements; (b) in store/modules/cashDrawer.js loadCurrentSession line 64-83 also fetch movements when session is OPEN; (c) gate the 'Cloturer la caisse' transition (dialog line 153) behind an await loadMovements so the close view never renders a stale 0-movements expected. File is NOT in the frozen list (frozen cash files = FiscalSequenceService/ZReportService/AuditLogService) -> fix directly, no GATE-ESCALATION. After fix re-capture 12a and assert 'Montant attendu' == 50 + sum(IN movements) and 'Mouvements' == ledger row count.
